summary.zh: 用排队模型测算人力需求与招聘顺序
summary.en: Size support teams with Erlang C and plan hiring order.

description.zh: 用 Erlang C 排队模型测算客服或运维团队需要多少人，评估利用率过高带来的风险，并给出招聘先后顺序。适合新团队定编、旺季排班或团队明显超载时使用。
description.en: Sizes support and ops teams with Erlang C queue models, flags utilization risk and ranks hires by impact. Useful for headcount planning, peak-season staffing or when a team is clearly overloaded.
